question: Identify schools in Los Angeles County that are non-charter, have a K-12 free meal eligibility rate below 25%, and serve more than 400 total enrolled students (K–12 plus ages 5–17). Among these, find the one with the highest average SAT Reading score and return its name, district, city, and that reading score.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_047, s.XCL_046, s.XCL_050, t.XCL_038
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores t ON s.XCL_041 = t.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.XCL_063 = 0
  AND CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 < 0.25
  AND (f.XCL_019 + f.XCL_024) > 400
ORDER BY t.XCL_038 DESC
LIMIT 1
